# 06 — Domain Mapping (spec §5–12)

*Generated by `tools/audit/render_matrix_docs.py` from the capability cards (`capabilities/**/card.yaml`) and the extraction summary.*

Domains are the user-facing architecture; upstream repositories appear only as provenance. `On-disk est. tokens` = bundled bytes ÷ 4 (**estimate**, spec §46). It is the size available to load, not what is loaded: the context engine (P9) loads L1 summaries first and L2/L3 files only when selected.
